enable_dbserver.description: Enable the database server (VLServer) daemon. Disable only for debugging or maintenance.

threads.description: Number of worker threads for handling database requests. Set based on expected load and CPU cores.

maxentries.description: Maximum number of in-memory database entries (cells, users, groups). Increase for large deployments.

workdir.description: Working directory for the database server. Must be writable by the openafs user.

logpath.description: Path to the database server log file. Ensure log rotation is configured.

peers.description: List of other database (VLServer) nodes in the cluster. Each must be reachable and synchronized.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the peer DB server.

port.description: Port number for the peer database server (default 7007).

cells.description: List of AFS cells managed by this DB server. At least one cell must be defined.

dbpath.description: Path to the cell's database files (usually /usr/afs/db on the cell server).

verbose.description: Enable verbose debug logging. Use only for troubleshooting — may impact performance.

backup_mode.description: Start in backup (standalone) mode. Use only during recovery or initial setup.

maxdumpsize.description: Maximum size (in MB) for each database dump file. Dumps are split at this size.

dumppath.description: Directory to store database dump files for backup and recovery.

use_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for inter-server communication (VLServer ↔ VLServer).

tls_cert_path.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_key_path.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.
